title: Female user — sex-specific BMR path, floors, and warning thresholds

expectations.assert: small female + cut: raw TDEE−400 likely near/below floor — floor 1200 applies; clamp VISIBLE (calorieFloorApplied), never silent
low-calorie warning threshold for females = BMR (compared against raw pre-floor value)
floors are labeled PRODUCT_POLICY convention, not evidence; VLCD territory (<800) never issuable
future plateau cuts blocked when at floor — the step/expenditure lever is the only remaining direction (coupled-variable resolution)
clamp verdict with visible reason codes at checkpoint 1 when floor engages
